home.heroTitle: The trusted guide to every corner of your home.
home.heroSub: Pool, HVAC, pest, plumbing, lighting, landscape, hardscape — plus a hand-picked network of local pros who actually show up.
home.howStep1Body: Pick your service and zip code. Takes 30 seconds.
home.howStep2Body: We route you to a vetted local pro we'd trust in our own home.
home.howStep3Body: Confirm the job, and get back to enjoying your home.
home.whyTitle: We hold the standard — so you don't have to.
home.whyBody1: Homefront Journal was built by people who actually work in home services. We know what a good job looks like, and we know what it costs when you hire the wrong person. So we built a resource that cuts through the noise.
home.whyBody2: Every pro we recommend has been vetted. Every article we publish is written to help you make smarter decisions — not to sell you something you don't need.
home.finalSub: Get matched with a vetted local pro in under a minute.
